recipe_version.title: Swiss Rösti with Smoked Trout and Dill-Caper Salad
recipe_version.description: One large golden potato rösti, pan-fried in oil until shatteringly crisp outside and tender inside, cut into wedges and topped with flaked smoked trout and a lemony arugula, cucumber, radish, dill, and caper salad in a Dijon vinaigrette.

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: 3 tbsp first side, 2 tbsp second side

steps.title: Grate and squeeze
steps.body: Peel and coarsely grate the potatoes and grate the shallot. Pile them in the center of a clean kitchen towel, twist it closed, and wring out as much liquid as you can (this is what makes the rösti crisp). Toss in a bowl with 1 1/4 tsp salt and the pepper. Slice the cucumbers and radishes, chop the dill, snip the chives, and flake the trout.

steps.title: Pan-fry the first side
steps.body: Heat 3 tbsp neutral oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high until shimmering. Add the potatoes, spread them into an even 3/4-inch layer, and press flat with a spatula. Cook 2 minutes to set, then lower to medium and cook without stirring until the underside is deep golden and crisp, about 12 minutes more. Shake the pan now and then so the cake slides freely.

steps.title: Make the salad
steps.body: While the first side cooks, whisk the lemon juice, Dijon, olive oil, and 1/4 tsp salt in a bowl. Add the arugula, cucumbers, radishes, dill, and capers but do not toss yet. Runs inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Flip and finish
steps.body: Slide the rösti onto a large plate, cover it with a second plate, invert, and slide it back into the skillet with 2 tbsp more oil around the edges. Cook over medium until the second side is deep golden and a knife slides through the center easily, 12 minutes.

steps.title: Top and serve
steps.body: Slide the rösti onto a board and cut into 4 wedges. Toss the salad. Top each wedge with trout and a handful of salad, scatter chives, and serve with lemon wedges.

coverage_contribution: Swiss 0 to 1. First potato-cake format. Smoked trout is a new protein form (deli-ready fish). HH001 brunch-style dinner.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with pan-fried trout with lemon and capers: no fresh fillet is cooked here; the potato cake is the main and the trout is cold-flaked. Compared with spanish-potato-tortilla and potato-leek-gratin: grated potato crisped in one cake, no egg, no cream. Compared with salade niçoise: hot crisp potato cake, not a composed cold salad.
not_duplicate_of: Not latkes (egg and flour binder, small fritters). Not raclette (cheese-led).
